entries.dialogueText: The grand Rizia-Pales reunion was right around the corner. Preparations were complete, our teams were cooperating and the marriage between Vina and Axel seemed to be going well. It wasn't a distant dream anymore.

entries.title: Narrator: "The only thing that was left was Du..."

entries.dialogueText: We were on the picturesque beach of Monqiz, sitting in front of a cafe run by distant Toras relatives in a secluded corner of the sandy shores.

entries.dialogueText: "It's refreshing being here, away from the court's rigidity. Life's simpler rhythms have a charm of their own."

entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Perhaps so. She definitely has a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps so. She definitely has a spirit too vast for the confines of stone walls."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I guess they were.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess they were."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you think your brother will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think your brother will be a problem?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you having second thoughts now?""

entries.dialogueText: "He had his chance to rule. If he hadn't taken the coward's way out, none of this would be happening."
